description: As the Data Governance Manager at a management consulting firm, a recent security audit has uncovered cross-module data integrity violations in SuiteCRM that could affect regulatory reporting and client communications. Investigate and correct all of the following categories of issues: (1) Account type classifications that contradict opportunity history. Any account with at least one Closed Won opportunity should be typed 'Customer'; accounts with no Closed Won business should not carry the 'Customer' type. (2) Contacts linked to accounts that no longer exist or have been deleted must be reassigned to the correct account. Use context clues such as email domain, job title, and description to determine correct assignments. (3) Contacts whose account assignment contradicts their email domain must be corrected. Audit every module and fix all integrity violations. Accounts typed as 'Partner' or 'Competitor' that accurately reflect their real-world relationship should not be changed regardless of opportunity history.
